dedupe_keys.name: stormwater bmp event sampling uncertainty workflow

description: This repository publishes Python and R scripts for designing stormwater-control monitoring frequency. Its README describes filtering 2024 International Stormwater BMP Database event-mean-concentration records for copper, suspended solids and phosphorus groups with at least 20 events in a parent inflow or outflow series. The code then draws 500 subsamples at five event counts and compares their concentrations with the parent data using relative percent difference. A modeller or monitoring planner could use those uncertainty curves to choose event sample sizes or test how sparse calibration data affect stormwater-quality estimates. The repository provides the SQL filter and scripts, but not the source Microsoft Access database or extracted Excel files; obtaining that input is a separate task. This review read the documentation, copyright notice and file tree without running scripts or checking any numeric output. The code is AGPL v3 or later under its copyright statement. Original BMP database records have separate terms that were not verified. Related resources are the BMP database and any derived event-concentration samples, not a ready national time series here. The producing team is the Southern California Coastal Water Research Project group named in the copyright notice. Its simulation use is choosing event-sampling inputs for stormwater-quality calibration and uncertainty tests.
